newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London climb in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London climb in thin trade.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London crept higher on Monday, buoyed by strength in the London and New York stock markets, dealers said.
The Hang Seng London Reference index advanced 33.16 points to close at 11,245.78. Overnight in Hong Kong, the Hang Seng finished up 187.01 points at 11,212.60.
"We've just had a mark-up across the board in blue chips," commented one London trader.
Gains made in the London market helped lift shares in HSBC Holdings which dragged other Hong Kong stocks higher, traders said.
HSBC rose HK$ 0.50 from its Hong Kong close to end in London at HK$ 134.50.
Relief over U.S. jobs data released on Friday also helped support prices, traders added.
Fears that the Federal Reserve may raise rates aggressively on the back of the data were dispelled when U.S. employment came in roughly in-line with expectations.
